decisions.statement: The color answered is read from the cost and the surplus together.
The rule turning the cost and the surplus into a color is the cost color module's.
The surplus handed to that rule is the figure in hours rather than a tier.
The color is worked out without the scale the surplus readout's page names.
The tier on the surplus carried is read against the scale the surplus readout's page names.
The surplus readout read beside the cost is the one readout named here.
A cost readout names no scale.
The shared group serving colors no cost readout.
The readouts answered are the ones whose page names the cost group.
The readouts are answered in the order the place on each page states.
The label and the wire key answered are the ones the readout's page carries.
A readout whose page names no label or no wire key is left out.
A readout whose page stills the readout is left out rather than answered.
A cost with no reading is answered as a stoplight carrying no figure.
The color of a stoplight with no figure is the color below every rung.
A cost above nothing carries the whole surplus stoplight its color was read with.
The surplus carried is the surplus answered rather than a second reach for the surplus.
A cost of nothing carries no surplus.
No wait is worked out here.
The stoplight carries everything the tile needs to work a wait.
A wait is divided by the rate the surplus falls at rather than by the cost itself.
A cost above nothing means a surplus falling.
The block priced is a block the surplus sums.
No stoplight carries a tier above or a fraction climbed.
A group no readout is left in is answered as no reading rather than as empty.
A store that refuses the group answers as a group holding nothing answers.
Nothing between here and the tile is allowed to keep an answer.
Nothing here takes a reading.
Nothing here decides when a reading is too old.
Nothing here reads a person or a device.
A cost beside a surplus nothing was read for is black.
A surplus nothing carried is not carried.

definition: the cost answered as a stoplight, colored with the surplus in hours
